_comment: Release 1B — Hook Manifest. Round 13. Status: DRAFTED. No source files supplied.
_preparation: Hook source files are a preauthorization blocker (B-HOOKS). This manifest describes what must be supplied.

hook_classes.baseline_reproduction: Represents existing production behavior from Release 1A
hook_classes.capability_probe: Local-only diagnostic code; never deployed to production
hook_classes.candidate_hardening: Possible future production code; not authorized for production deployment
hook_classes.provider_mock: Local-only simulation; never contacts external provider

required_hooks.name: alias_interceptor
required_hooks.purpose: Intercept auth-with-password requests; enforce timing and response uniformity for alias accounts

actor_behavior.ordinary: N/A — this is a login hook
actor_behavior.app_admin: N/A — this is a login hook
actor_behavior.app_superadmin: N/A — this is a login hook
actor_behavior.native_superuser: Hook behavior when NSU token is used — must be explicitly tested

required_hooks.local_configuration: Uses RELEASE1B_ISOLATED_ROOT paths only; no production endpoints
required_hooks.activation_test: T-ALIAS-INTERCEPTOR-ACTIVE: anonymous wrong-pw returns 400, not 404 or 500
required_hooks.removal_test: T-HOOK-REMOVE-alias_interceptor: route reverts to default PocketBase behavior

required_hooks.name: role_hardening
required_hooks.purpose: Enforce that role, phone, phone_verified, and is_alias_account fields cannot be self-modified by ordinary users

actor_behavior.anon: No auth — rejected at collection rule before hook
actor_behavior.ordinary: Protected fields blocked; safe fields allowed
actor_behavior.app_admin: Can modify role up to admin; cannot grant superadmin
actor_behavior.app_superadmin: Cannot self-modify or demote without superadmin confirmation
actor_behavior.native_superuser: Must be tested explicitly — hook may bypass or process

required_hooks.activation_test: T-FIELD-ROLE: ordinary user PATCH role=admin returns 403
required_hooks.removal_test: After removal: PATCH role=admin succeeds if only collection rule present (or still blocked — baseline must be documented)

required_hooks.name: consent_gate
required_hooks.purpose: Gate file and content access behind current consent version

actor_behavior.ordinary: Allowed only if latest consent version accepted

required_hooks.local_configuration: Consent version constant set to test value; no production consent API
required_hooks.activation_test: T-FILE-AUTH-5: file denied when consent version insufficient
required_hooks.removal_test: After removal: file accessible without consent check

required_hooks.name: otp_phone_link
required_hooks.purpose: Authenticated legacy phone linking via OTP; requires ordinary user token
required_hooks.local_configuration: MOCK_PROVIDER_URL set to local mock provider endpoint; no Meta contact

required_hooks.name: mock_provider
required_hooks.purpose: Local-only OTP provider simulator; accepts MOCK_PHONE_LOCAL; never contacts Meta or any external service

actor_behavior.all: Accepts local test phone number; returns fake OTP code; logs to isolated root only

required_hooks.local_configuration: MOCK_PHONE_LOCAL constant defined in hook; no external network calls
required_hooks.note: Must never route any request outside loopback. Must verify no outbound connection is made.

phone_test_values.usage: Direct protected-field write tests only; verifies the field cannot be set
phone_test_values.mock_usage: Passed to mock provider only; accepted only by mock_provider hook; never routed externally
phone_test_values.real_number_policy: A real consenting subscriber number may be used only in a separately authorized production OTP test; not part of Checkpoint 0

hooks_not_required_at_checkpoint_0.name: phone_first_register
hooks_not_required_at_checkpoint_0.reason: Anonymous phone-first flow is future release; disabled feature flag; not deployed

hooks_not_required_at_checkpoint_0.name: push_broadcast
hooks_not_required_at_checkpoint_0.reason: Separately deferred defect; outside Release 1B scope
